meta_description: JCK Decorating brings expert interior and exterior painting to Southampton. Reliable, professional finishes. Free quotes. Call 07516 956214.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Southampton & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior painting, we deliver flawless finishes on time and within budget.
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house repaint, we handle interior and exterior work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Redecorating
services.desc: Transform your living spaces with expert wall preparation, paint selection guidance, and flawless application. We protect your furniture and floors, leaving no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's facade with weather-resistant exterior paints. We handle facias, soffits, doors, and window frames to withstand Southampton's climate.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Bring personality to your rooms with bold feature walls and complementary colour schemes. We help you choose the right finish and execute it perfectly.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, architraves, doors, and shutters deserve expert attention. We sand, prime, and finish to a showroom standard.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation or careful removal without damaging plaster. We source premium papers and ensure perfect alignment and seams.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and small commercial properties painted to tight schedules. We minimise disruption and deliver professional results on budget.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own — no shortcuts, no filler.
about_para_1: JCK Decorating was established over a decade ago with a simple mission: bring affordable, high-quality painting and decorating to Southampton homes and businesses. We've spent twelve years perfecting our craft, building a reputation for attention to detail and honest, straightforward pricing. Every project starts with a thorough site survey and a realistic quote — no hidden costs.
about_para_2: Homeowners return to us because we listen, deliver on time, and stand behind our work. Whether you're refreshing a bedroom or repainting the whole exterior, we take pride in the finish. We're local, reliable, and we work around your schedule so your life isn't turned upside down.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About JCK Decorating

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs redecorated. Jack and his team were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. They moved furniture carefully and cleaned up every day. The quality of the paint finish is exceptional. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Got a free quote in two days and the price was genuinely competitive. They started on time and the team was polite and efficient. Exterior paintwork looks brand new. Really pleased with the job.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Came back for a second project because the first was so good. They remembered exactly what we wanted and got on with it without any faffing. Fair pricing, no surprises. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: Paul M.
